title: The Outsider
subtitle: A dependency in another group
description: A dependency that leaves this chapter and this group entirely:
`the_hoard` is a quest in The Trade. A dependsOn may name any
quest anywhere in the tree, which is how a hub chapter reaches
into the chapters it depends on.
`prerequisiteMode: all_completed` is written out on this file
because the chapter's default is one_started -- and a cross-group
edge that only needs its neighbour *started* would not feel
If you only play this group, this node stays locked until you
have done someone else's hoard. That is exactly what the edge
means, and it is why it is the only one.
